full_judgment: 2. A brick field belonging to respondent No. 1 was acquired by the Government for the Requiring Body-petitioner in LA Case No. 1/1983-84 under the Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance, 1982. Respondent No. 1 claimed Taka 57,03,056.00 as compensation under various heads, but the Deputy Commissioner, Pabna awarded an amount of Taka 28,55,000.00 on 1.2.86 against which respondent No. 1 preferred Miscellaneous Case (Arbitration) No. 38 of 1986 before the Arbitrator claiming Taka 92,68,050.00 less Taka 28,55,000.00 already received. The Arbitrator passed an award for a sum of Taka 42,55,000.00 on 29.10.92. Respondent No. 1 then preferred Arbitration Miscellaneous Appeal No. 88 of 1982 before the Appellate Tribunal which by judgment and order dated 30.6.93 increased the amount of award to a sum of Taka 45,46,827.00. The present petitioner as requiring Body-petitioner preferred Civil Revision No. 2918 of 1993 and respondent No. 1 as Awardee preferred Civil Revision No. 2911 of 1993 against the Appellate Tribunal's judgment dated 30.6.93.
